sources.title: THC Cannabis Plant Science Source Packet v1.1
sources.useAndLimitation: Internal controlled architecture and Cannabis genetics source map; final claims require direct-source verification.

sources.title: THC Cultivation SOP Source Materials Packet v1.0
sources.useAndLimitation: Internal controlled source map for identity, biosecurity, records, testing, and safety boundaries.

sources.title: THC Master Content Compilation and Merge Register v1.0
sources.useAndLimitation: Permanent THC-ENC IDs, domains, completion rules, and release gates.

sources.title: Allard — Principles of Plant Breeding
sources.useAndLimitation: Foundational mating systems, selection, population improvement, backcrossing, and line development; general plant breeding, not Cannabis-specific.

sources.title: Acquaah — Principles of Plant Genetics and Breeding
sources.useAndLimitation: Plant breeding objectives, methods, experimental design, cultivar development, and germplasm use; textbook source.

sources.title: Falconer and Mackay — Introduction to Quantitative Genetics
sources.useAndLimitation: Inbreeding, variance, heritability, selection response, and quantitative-trait foundations; model assumptions must be stated.

sources.title: Bernardo — Breeding for Quantitative Traits in Plants
sources.useAndLimitation: Selection, prediction, multi-environment testing, genetic gain, and genomic selection; general crop-breeding source.

sources.title: Sawler et al. 2015 — The Genetic Structure of Marijuana and Hemp
sources.useAndLimitation: Genome-wide differentiation and limitations of commercial strain ancestry labels.

sources.title: Ren et al. 2021 — Large-scale whole-genome resequencing and Cannabis domestication
sources.useAndLimitation: Global population history, domestication, and selection; sampled accessions and historical interpretation limit generalization.

sources.title: Lynch et al. 2025 — Cannabis pangenome
sources.useAndLimitation: Structural variation, population mosaic, sex chromosomes, and cannabinoid synthase diversity; research genomes do not replace line-specific testing.

sources.title: Stansell et al. 2025 — U.S. feral Cannabis germplasm diversity
sources.useAndLimitation: Large U.S. feral collection, population structure, chemotype, and conservation value; feral material requires legal and agronomic qualification.

sources.title: Iranian Cannabis population genomics and GWAS, 2025
sources.useAndLimitation: Genetic structure and marker associations for flowering, morphology, sex, yield, and chemotype; population-specific associations require validation.

sources.title: Developing and Testing Molecular Markers in Cannabis, 2021
sources.useAndLimitation: SSR marker development, variety discrimination, diversity, and dioecy assessment; marker panels have population limits.

sources.title: Prentout et al. 2020 — Cannabis sex chromosomes
sources.useAndLimitation: Family-based RNA-seq segregation supporting XX/XY sex chromosomes and sex-linked genes.

sources.title: Riera-Begue et al. 2025 — PCR-based XX/XY sex genotyping
sources.useAndLimitation: Single-pair PCR marker tested across hemp cultivars and crosses; additional germplasm validation remains prudent.

sources.title: Leckie et al. 2024 — Genetic basis of daylength-insensitive flowering
sources.useAndLimitation: Cannabis-specific evidence for loss of photoperiod sensitivity; flowering remains background and environment dependent.

sources.title: Lubell and Brand 2018 — Silver thiosulfate produces male flowers on female hemp
sources.useAndLimitation: Foundational Cannabis sex-reversal experiment; genotype, dose, timing, chemical safety, waste, and legal controls apply.

sources.title: Flajšman et al. 2021 — Feminized seed production by manipulation of sex expression
sources.useAndLimitation: Cannabis-specific STS/colloidal-silver studies and progeny context; no universal operating recipe.

sources.title: Characterization of male flower induction by STS, 2024
sources.useAndLimitation: Three-cultivar study showing genotype, stage, concentration, and treatment response differences.

sources.title: Weiblen et al. 2015 — Inheritance of chemical phenotype
sources.useAndLimitation: Classic biparental chemotype segregation study; major ratio locus does not explain all concentration variation.

sources.title: Campbell et al. 2020 — Cannabinoid inheritance relies on complex architecture
sources.useAndLimitation: Line-cross evidence for additive, dominance, maternal, and polygenic effects on cannabinoid concentrations.

sources.title: Grassa et al. 2021 — CBDRx chromosome-resolved genome and QTL
sources.useAndLimitation: Cannabinoid synthase arrays, hemp introgression, and QTL context; one population and reference background.

sources.title: Vergara et al. 2020 — Gene copy number and phytochemistry
sources.useAndLimitation: Cannabinoid-pathway copy-number variation and expression associations; copy number only partly explains phenotype.

sources.title: Structure of the chemotype-determining locus, 2026
sources.useAndLimitation: High-quality genome analysis describing a structurally variable supergene-like B locus; new evidence requiring independent review before release.

sources.title: Machine-learning multi-trait genomic prediction for cannabinoids, 2025
sources.useAndLimitation: High-density genotyping and genomic-prediction research; prediction depends on training population and validation.

sources.title: Stack et al. 2024 — CsMLO1 powdery mildew susceptibility locus
sources.useAndLimitation: Large F2 mapping populations, major and minor QTL, and markers; pathogen and population specific.

sources.title: Seifi et al. 2025 — PM2 powdery mildew resistance locus
sources.useAndLimitation: Dominant chromosome-9 resistance locus and associated markers; requires background and isolate validation.

sources.title: Vignale et al. 2026 — Diverse germplasm screening for powdery mildew resistance
sources.useAndLimitation: Two-year screening of USDA, breeding, and commercial entries; low severity supports further characterization, not automatic release claims.

sources.title: Cannabis disease and resistance source registers from Volumes 15–17
sources.useAndLimitation: Organism identity, screening, epidemiology, and IPM boundaries; internal cross-volume source map.

sources.title: FAO Genebank Standards for Plant Genetic Resources
sources.useAndLimitation: Acquisition, drying, storage, viability monitoring, regeneration, documentation, safety duplication, and security benchmarks.

sources.title: USDA-ARS hemp germplasm repository and GRIN-Global records
sources.useAndLimitation: Public germplasm conservation, identity, characterization, and distribution context; accession availability and rules change.

sources.title: ISTA International Rules for Seed Testing
sources.useAndLimitation: Seed sampling, germination, purity, moisture, and reporting methods; current edition and crop method must be verified.

sources.title: Challenges and potentials of new breeding techniques in Cannabis, 2023
sources.useAndLimitation: Review of Cannabis diversity, breeding, selfing, markers, transformation, and editing limitations.

sources.title: Current cultivar, seed, intellectual-property, phytosanitary, and cannabis rules
sources.useAndLimitation: Naming, release, ownership, seed movement, testing, and legal status are jurisdiction- and date-specific.
